about_the_game:
Synopsis

One day, many creatures called monsters were transformed into monsters by the Demon King, a being from another world, and the world began to be invaded by the Demon King.

The Demon King's invasion continues, and after three years of countless warriors being killed by the Demon King... Finally, one warrior with special abilities begins his journey to the Demon King...

There is no retreat. Continue the story of a warrior who only moves forward.

Manage your items efficiently to reach the final stage.

Luck is a factor, but item management is what makes all the difference in this game.

You can unlock and strengthen items or characteristics with the dreamstones you obtain while playing the game.

How many items can you get?

How far can you reach?

And why does the warrior embark on such a journey with no retreat?

If you look closely, you will see the answer.

No... you will find out.

  • Uncover the journey and secrets of a warrior who has no choice but to move forward as a warrior.

Why did the warrior set out on a journey with no retreat?

And what fate awaits the warrior at the end of his journey?

Will everything end when the Demon King is defeated?

Become a hero and uncover the mysteries that have happened to the hero.

Why on earth did the hero set out on this journey, and the secrets of the other characters.

At the end of this long journey, or perhaps during this long journey, you will discover the secret.

  • Choose your traits.

The warrior's six teachers left behind great teachings for the warrior and then disappeared.

Make your arduous journey a little easier by recalling one of the teachings of your masters.

But there are probably teachings that have been forgotten in countless memories. They are a difficult subject to talk to.

The only one who can bring back those memories is... probably the witch in the mystery shop.

  • Kill any enemies you encounter.

The fiends created by the Demon King are truly troublesome opponents.

They will only counter your attacks, but they are still a pain in the ass once you encounter them.

However, you can also get some very good ideologies from fiends.

That is, the fiend you encounter can be a trial, but it can also be an opportunity.

Will you be able to get good ideologies from the fiends?

  • Make good use of the items you obtain.

All ideologies created by the warrior's abilities have the fatal flaw of poor durability.

What can complement that is your ability to manage your belongings.

If you use your limited inventory appropriately, you will definitely have no major problems in later fights.

Don't forget.

Since inventory slots are limited, your item management skills determine everything except luck.

  • Defeat the boss to advance to the next chapter.

In each location, there are beings who are like gatekeepers waiting for you.

It will appear in front of you at the end of the path that will lead you to the next location.

They are powerful beings.

You must gear up and challenge them before reaching the end of the path.

But... these guards blocking your path...

Why does it seem like you have a friendly side to the warrior?

  • Use the items you earn to get various bonuses from the shop.

The shop is a mysterious shop run by a witch.

Here, the warrior can gain memories of new items or strengthen the thoughts or memories of items he currently holds.

If you do so, you will be able to obtain more items during your journey, and your ideologies will be further strengthened.

All goods used in the shop can be obtained during and at the end of the journey.

Don't forget.

The witch in the shop will definitely help you on your journey.
